summary: Authenticated backend and mobile web regression passed. Login, tabs, journal CRUD/filter, discipline notes, AI result, account creation, target mode edits, all PDF launch actions, and 390x844 overflow checks completed successfully.

integration_issues.issue: Home persists a selected account, but journal, discipline, assistant, and settings load accounts[0] instead of the persisted selection; operations/notes/AI/settings can therefore target the wrong account after switching.

action_items: Use the persisted account selection consistently in journal, discipline, assistant, and settings instead of always choosing the first account.
Remove default URL/DB fallback values where deployment contract requires environment variables to fail fast.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend and live Expo configuration use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with EXPO_BACKEND_URL fallback; the requested contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
backend/server.py uses os.environ.get('DB_NAME', 'trading_journal') despite the environment contract requiring DB_NAME from backend/.env without a default.
Expo web logs the expected expo-notifications push-token limitation; native notification permission/scheduling was not verifiable in web preview.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executed flows (login, navigation, journal CRUD/filter, discipline CRUD, AI, account create/edit, reports, responsive overflow)

seed_data_creation: UI test created and deleted a TEST_UI_XAU trade and TEST UI discipline note. TEST UI Account was created for account/settings testing and remains in the QA account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use qa.apextrade@example.com / ApexTrade123. Preview: https://trader-daily-tracker.preview.emergentagent.com. AI returned a Spanish result; PDF buttons opened new authenticated tabs; body width equaled viewport width at 390px.
rca_of_issue: The cross-screen account isolation issue is visible in source: Home stores apextrade_account but other screens call getAccounts() and select list[0]. Reproduction: create a second account, select it in Home/Settings, open Journal or Discipline, and observe requests use the first account ID.
